hero.description: Delivering engineering and experience across the full e-commerce SaaS stack — using AI to amplify judgment, and data to validate intuition.

about.heading: About
about.subtitle: Background & Direction
about.currentWorkDesc: Frontend engineering at ThoughtWorks on e-commerce SaaS, currently exploring and contributing to a cross-team AI Playbook.
about.bio1: My background is in architecture and UX — coming into frontend engineering, that turned out to shape how I see problems more than I expected. I tend to look at systems from the flow down rather than the feature up: noticing where chains break before they become visible, and wanting to fix things upstream rather than waiting for them to surface.
about.bio2: That perspective comes from a flow-mapping mindset — understanding where users get stuck is closer to the root of a problem than understanding what they 'want'.
about.bio3: Working at the intersection of engineering and experience, I've always felt that "can we ship it" and "is it worth shipping" matter equally. AI makes this more interesting — not just as a way to move faster, but as a reason to rethink how delivery itself works.
about.bio4: Now breaking these down into articles and demos — systematically validating where AI genuinely adds value across each layer of e-commerce SaaS.
